capabilities: propagate group colors to uncolored notes via weighted breadth-first search
read color groups defined in the Graph view Groups panel
adjust propagation with decay factor, max hops, and min influence settings
apply colors manually via ribbon icon, command, or settings button
extras: Desktop only; relies on the desktop Graph view renderer internals and does not work on mobile. Propagated colors are visual only and are not written back into graph.json. Includes a debug command that dumps node structure to the console.
intentEvidence: Define color groups in Obsidian's built-in Graph view → Groups panel as usual — this plugin reads those groups
problem: Obsidian's Graph view only colors notes that match a group query, leaving linked notes without a group uncolored.
summary: Graph view extension that propagates colors from defined color groups to uncolored notes, weighted by link distance and path count.
